# Encircle Game Studio
> The games division of Encircle Technologies Private Limited, based in Rajkot, India. It makes mobile games for iPhone, iPad and Android, available on the App Store and Google Play.
- [Tower Tap](https://encircle-game-studio.github.io/towertap/): A one-tap stacking game where you rebuild famous towers from their blueprints, floor by floor, on phones, tablets and Chrome.
- [Highway Brawlers](https://encircle-game-studio.github.io/highwaybrawlers/): A 3D motorcycle combat racer where you punch and kick rivals off their bikes on two-way highways. Races play offline.
- [Letter Leaves](https://encircle-game-studio.github.io/letterleaves/): An English spelling, phonics and reading game for children aged 5 to 11, with no ads and nothing collected.

## Data
- [games.json](https://encircle-game-studio.github.io/games.json): every game with its page and store links.
